notes.title: POPSLINGER X MAKESHIP RIA CARBON PLUSH COLLABORATION!
notes.content:
[url=https://shop.makeship.com/3V4I347][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42110743/6a52a9e7f41b428992038f9fac400da31385f291.png[/img][/url]

Something's turned up in the funky streets of Set District!! Ria and Gin are about to find a... Ria Carbon Plushie?!?!😯😯

[h1]She looks sooooo CUTE![/h1]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42110743/86e36df65655a7f0ca4b45f0fe6c2721b88eedc3.png[/img]

[i]Check her out! She's standing there ready to POP everything on sight!
[/i]

[h3]This Ria Plushie looks exactly like the real one! She's even COMBAT READY with her soda gun handy!![/h3]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42110743/f22c9c4d3f67e66af0f20d49534288a4a02faf5c.png[/img]

[i]Not only was her orange soda gun kept, she also has her cool jacket decal!! Fizzing!!
[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42110743/71295f22edf0f77987265dba78a99782460d75a9.png[/img]

[h3]Includes an exclusive digital wallpaper with every purchase![/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42110743/6aa378a07ce4fd9222f3b74369aa1294a8a94ab5.jpg[/img]

Once you get a Ria plush, you'll have access to an exclusive and VERY funky wallpaper for desktop and mobile designed by [url=https://twitter.com/DiegoAndsMtz]PopSlinger's Main Artist![/url] Not just that, you will also[b] get an exclusive, never-before-heard bonus track by [url=https://twitter.com/Skule_Toyama]Skule Toyama![/url][/b]

Step right up to the [url=https://shop.makeship.com/3V4I347]campaign site[/url] and get your Ria plush now!🔫

The campaign starts from October 13th, 2022 to November 3rd, 2022 . Don't miss out! [b]Once the campaign is over, you won't be able to get her![/b]

Follow us on our socials to get more deetz and surprises during this campaign! 

Let's help the Ria Carbon Plushie SAVE THE WORLD! 💖💖

- Funky Can Creative Dev Team!
